title: Hessian operators, null Lagrangians and the integral comparison principle
summary: We investigate the conditions under which a Hessian operator satisfies the integral comparison principle. We establish a rather unexpected connection with the notion of a null Lagrangian from the calculus of variations. Under mild conditions we obtain a complete classification, showing that the only operators for which the integral comparison principle holds are linear combinations of $k$-Hessians and, in the homogeneous case, precisely the $k$-Hessians themselves.
